# Banco de Portugal Economic Bulletin, October 2026

The [October 2026 Economic Bulletin](https://www.bportugal.pt/sites/default/files/documents/2026-10/be_out2026_pt.pdf)
provides macroeconomic projections for the Portuguese economy over
**2026–2028**. Its forecast exercise uses information available through
**30 September 2026**, while the publication itself is dated 7 October 2026.

The downstream `social-security-housing-investment` source manifest
`data/sources/investment_comparison_sources.json` records:

- PDF file: `be_out2026_pt.pdf`, 4,190,155 bytes.
- SHA-256: `882eaed41f70ce0416479e57f2726c4f2c795e85865623e1c770216937ef0551`.
- Project retrieval date: 30 October 2026.
- Projection table: **Quadro I.1.1**; EURIBOR assumptions in **Quadro C1.1**.

| Projected indicator | 2026 | 2027 | 2028 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Real GDP growth | 2.3% | 1.8% | 1.8% |
| HICP inflation | 3.1% | 2.4% | 2.0% |

The values are **conditional forecasts**, not observed annual statistics.
The report's market-rate assumptions reflect an earlier cut-off date and
must not be represented as current offered interest rates or guaranteed
returns. A housing-investment model's discount rate remains an assumption,
even if informed by these official projections.

Banco de Portugal's [published reuse notice](https://clientebancario.bportugal.pt/pt-pt/avisos-legais)
permits use of information obtained directly from its website with accurate
reproduction, source acknowledgement and explicit disclosure of changes.
That statement is not a licence to reproduce unrelated third-party content.
The upstream document and research extracts remain external; this registry
does not mirror their bytes.
